_doc: Written (human) card descriptions. cards: card id -> {name, text: {part key -> text}}. Part keys are those of textParts() in js/content/cards.js: body (a spell's own effect), passives:N, triggers:N, rider, abilities:N. The id is the card's identity; name must equal the card's name (the tests check every entry). Shown when the inspector's Text button is on Written; a part with no entry shows its generated text.

text.abilities:0: Fast. You have lost life: sacrifice this card, then gain 3 life. (Stack HP 2)

text.body: Quick, 0 HP (still resolves). Deal 1 damage to the opponent.

text.abilities:0: Slow. Front row: pay 1 life; deal 2 damage to the opponent. (Stack HP 1)
Fast. A creature faces this: sacrifice this card; deal 3 damage to that creature. (Stack HP 0)
Slow. Exile your oldest GY card; draw 1. (Stack HP 1)

text.body: Quick. Target a fully filled column: exile every card on it. That column becomes unusable for the rest of the game. Return this card to your hand. (Stack HP 6)
Quick. Deal 3 damage to the stack object beneath it (countered at HP -1 or lower).

text.triggers:0: When this enters: draw a card.
text.triggers:1: When this card or an opponent’s creature attacks: you may shift this card to an adjacent empty column.
text.abilities:0: Fast, from your GY: exile this card; gain 3 life. (Stack HP 1)

text.passives:0: Passive. A black cloud covers each of your other zones: your opponent cannot see those zones or the cards on them. Abilities of cards under a cloud appear to come from King Eye. A cloud is a legal target for anything that targets a card or zone there; the effect passes to what is underneath, and with nothing legal underneath it fizzles (nothing is revealed).

text.triggers:0: When this enters: 4 times, pick the closest zone (any row, back-row zones included) not occupied by this card or a Vine token, destroy the card there, and create a Vine token (1/1) on it, even in a zone a creature cannot normally enter.
text.triggers:1: At the start of your turn: do the same.

text.triggers:0: Whenever a creature attacks: you may shift this card to an adjacent empty column.
text.triggers:1: Whenever this card takes combat damage: deal 1 damage to another creature.
text.rider: Damage dealt by this card: that creature loses all its original abilities and gains the abilities of Avatar of Rabies.

text.body: Quick. Target a permanent: remove 7 damage counters from it (7 points, split across its damage instances as you choose). (Stack HP 10)
Slow. Deal 20 damage to any target (a permanent or a player). (Stack HP 3)
Slow. Target player mills ten cards. (Stack HP 2)

text.triggers:0: At the beginning of your combat step: double this card’s power 5 times.
When this enters: add a Superbolt from your deck to your hand.
When this enters: choose 5 cards from your deck and exile them (stack HP 7).
text.triggers:1: At the start of your turn: your opponent picks one of those exiled cards; put it into your hand.

text.triggers:0: When this enters, choose one effect unlocked by the number of creatures your opponent controls. 0: look at their hand and send a card to the GY. 1+: 4 damage to any target. 2+: return a card they control to hand. 3+: put a creature from your hand, GY or exile into play. 4+: draw cards equal to their creature count. 5: destroy all cards on the board.

text.abilities:0: Fast, from your hand: after an opposing creature attacks, if you control a creature in that column, return that creature to your hand and put this card into its zone. (Stack HP 1)

text.body: Quick, 0 HP. Choose one: each card you control gets a red shield counter (cannot be targeted), or each gets a blue shield counter (unaffected by spells and abilities that do not target it; attacks still hit it). You cannot gain life for the rest of the game.

text.passives:1: Passive: cards your opponent controls in this column and the adjacent columns get -1/-1.
text.triggers:0: When this enters, if the additional cost was paid: put a creature from your GY into play; it attacks immediately.
text.triggers:1: When this enters: create a Drummer token (3/3; cards you control in its column and the adjacent ones get +1/+1).

text.passives:0: Token. Cards you control in this column and the adjacent columns get +1/+1.

text.triggers:0: When this enters: you may pay 3 life; skip your opponent next combat phase (pressing combat becomes End turn instead).
text.triggers:1: After your first combat phase ends: you may have your opponent draw 5 cards (cost; does nothing if they cannot); enter a second combat phase, where creatures can attack again.

text.body: Quick. Draw until you have 7 cards in hand. You may target a creature or a spell: damage to it is denied until the end of this turn. (Stack HP 4)
text.abilities:0: From your GY, Fast, when your opponent attacks: exile this card; cancel that attack. (Stack HP 1)

text.body: Slow, 0 HP. In order: you draw 2; return up to 2 cards from your GY to your hand; put up to 2 creatures/enchantments from your hand into play. Then your opponent returns up to 2 cards from their GY to their hand, puts up to 2 creatures/enchantments from their GY into play, and draws 2.
Quick. Reveal an extra deck creature whose conditions are met and exile its materials from your GY; summon that creature. (Stack HP 10)
text.abilities:0: Fast, from your GY: exile this card; return an extra deck creature from your GY to the extra deck, and return the materials used to summon it from exile to your hand. (Stack HP 1)

text.body: Quick. Reveal an extra deck creature and send its materials from your field, hand or deck to the GY; summon it if its conditions are met (ignored if the materials come only from your hand and field). (Stack HP 7)
text.abilities:0: Fast, from your deck or GY: spend an action point; add this card to your hand. (Stack HP 1)

text.triggers:0: When this enters: reveal an extra deck creature; if its conditions are met, put its materials from your deck into your hand.
When this enters: target two adjacent cards your opponent controls; they send one of them to the GY.
text.triggers:1: When this attacks: target two adjacent cards your opponent controls; they send one of them to the GY.
text.triggers:2: When a card your opponent controls enters adjacent to another card they control: target a creature you control; it attacks.

text.triggers:0: When this enters, if it was summoned using Heaven and Sun: look at the top 3 cards of your opponent’s deck and put them back on top in any order.
text.triggers:1: When this enters: declare a card name, then look at the top card of your opponent’s deck; if it has that name you may play it, and repeat this effect.
text.triggers:2: At the start of your turn: draw a card.

text.abilities:0: Fast. Spend an attack counter on this card, target something with HP that is not a player: deal 3 temporary non-lethal damage to it. (Stack HP 1)

text.triggers:0: When this enters (1hp): secretly target an empty zone; that zone secretly gains "when a card enters this zone (2hp): consume this status; deal 1 damage to that card." Shifting in counts as entering.
text.triggers:1: At the start of your turn (1hp): secretly target an empty zone; that zone secretly gains "when a card enters this zone (2hp): consume this status; deal 1 damage to that card." Shifting in counts as entering.

text.body: Slow spell, 0 AP (1hp). Cost: reveal your hand. Your opponent secretly selects one of those cards; it secretly gains Duplicate (the status survives zone changes).
